factual_claims.claim: Additionally, underutilized production capacity increased the per-unit cost of goods, further pressuring margins.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Performance of Business Units: 'The EBITDA of Nordic Fibreboard Ltd OÜ was negative € 0.3 million in 2025 (2024: positive € 0.03 million). The negative EBITDA was a result of underutilized capacity which makes the own production of goods more expensive'

factual_claims.claim: The operating loss widened to 0.94 million euros from 0.55 million euros in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: EBITDA by Business Segments table: 'TOTAL OPERATING LOSS: (940) [2025] vs (547) [2024]'

factual_claims.claim: Depreciation charges remained stable at 0.52 million euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: EBITDA by Business Segments table: 'Deprecation: (520) [2025] vs (522) [2024]'

factual_claims.claim: Net financial costs were 0.21 million euros, slightly lower than the 0.24 million euros incurred in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: EBITDA by Business Segments table: 'Net financial cost: (214) [2025] vs (238) [2024]'

factual_claims.claim: Total assets increased to 9.3 million euros from 8.3 million euros, largely due to investments in production assets and real estate.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position: 'TOTAL ASSETS: 9,323 [2025] vs 8,252 [2024]'; Cash Flow Statement: 'Cash outflows due to investment activities was € 989 thousand in 2025, mainly consisting of investments into production assets of € 1 367 thousand and real estate related investments of € 161 thousand'

factual_claims.claim: Liabilities rose to 4.9 million euros from 4.6 million euros, with borrowings decreasing to 3.2 million euros from 3.7 million euros, while payables increased to 1.3 million euros from 0.4 million euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position: 'Total liabilities: 4,861 [2025] vs 4,636 [2024]'; 'Borrowings: 2,963 [2025] vs 1,111 [current] + 2,613 [non-current] = 3,724 [2024]'; 'Payables and prepayments: 1,553 [2025] vs 788 [2024]'

factual_claims.claim: Equity grew to 4.46 million euros from 3.62 million euros, supported by a share capital increase of 2 million euros completed in October 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Changes in Equity: 'Balance at 31.12.2025: 4,462 [Total equity] vs 3,616 [2024]'; Note 13: 'Increase in share capital: 2,000 [October 2025]'

factual_claims.claim: This capital raise involved the issuance of 4 million new shares at 0.50 euros each, aimed at facilitating trading on the Nasdaq Tallinn additional list.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 13: 'The issue price of the shares was 0.50 euros per share... Up to 4,000,000 shares were publicly offered... The newly issued shares will be entitled to dividends starting from the financial year 2025... admit them to trading on the additional list of the Nasdaq Tallinn Stock Exchange'

factual_claims.claim: The economic environment in Estonia remained challenging in 2025, with modest growth of 0.6 percent and weak domestic demand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Forecast and Development: 'Estonia's economic growth reached 0.6% in 2025... domestic demand remained weak'

factual_claims.claim: Inflation reached approximately 6 percent, driven by higher taxes and excise duties, which constrained household purchasing power.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Forecast and Development: 'Price growth was driven primarily by higher taxes — the vehicle tax, increases in VAT and excise duties — which together accounted for approximately one third of inflation, which reached around 6% for the year as a whole... The rise in income tax at the start of the year further reduced purchasing power for households'

factual_claims.claim: Despite a recovery in the wood industry output earlier in the year, conditions deteriorated towards the end of 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Forecast and Development: 'The wood industry... output in the sector rose by 8.3% in January of 2025... Nevertheless, conditions remained difficult towards the end of the year, with a modest 0.8% decline recorded in wood processing in October'

factual_claims.claim: The company’s main markets in the European Union accounted for 92 percent of sales, which remained relatively flat.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Groups`S REVENUE BY REGIONS table: 'European Union: 6,702 [2025] / 7,328 [total] = ~91.5%'; Management Report: 'Sales to the EU which makes up 92% of the sales held relatively flat'

factual_claims.claim: Sales to Africa and Asia saw the sharpest declines.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Groups`S REVENUE BY REGIONS table: 'Africa: 200 [2025] vs 305 [2024] (34% decrease); Asia: 161 [2025] vs 212 [2024] (24% decrease)' — these are the largest percentage drops among regions

factual_claims.claim: The Group employed 60 people at year-end, a reduction from 68 in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Personnel section: 'As at 31.12.2025 the Group employed 60 people (31.12.2024: 68 employees)'

factual_claims.claim: Looking forward, the company expects demand for fibreboards to remain stable and anticipates holding sales volumes at current levels.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Forecast and Development: 'Nordic Fibreboard Ltd OÜ expects demand for fibreboard to remain stable in the coming months and anticipates that sales volumes will hold at their current level'

factual_claims.claim: The Admirali Quarter development project has received necessary building permits, and a preliminary sale agreement for ten properties within the project was signed in January 2026 to help liquidate negative working capital.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Real Estate Management: 'Building permits have been issued for... apartment buildings at Admirali 1/3, Admirali 5/7 and Admirali 9/11'...'; Note 26: 'After the balance sheet date, on 08.01.2026 Nordic Fibreboard AS entered into a preliminary sale-purchase agreement for the sale of ten properties... to help liquidate negative working capital'
